Relax the Evidence grammar to accept a bare path

Citing a whole file is a normal citation, and the harvest verifier can
check it exactly as well as an anchored one.

Limit: the harvest verifier can only check citations it can resolve, so
  the grammar must not admit forms it cannot follow
Evidence: docs/adr/ADR-0009-rename-commitlore.md
Evidence: spec/SPEC.md#3-vocabulary
Evidence: https://example.org/reports/2026-07-audit
Certainty: firm
Record-Id: r-3c9f70
CommitLore-Version: 2.0.0
